Landscape by normalised convolution with a Gaussian kernel

Source: R/RcppExports.R
landscape_gauss.Rd

Landscape by normalised convolution with a Gaussian kernel

landscape_gauss(
  coord,
  SignalOut,
  signalExp,
  signalCtrl,
  resolutionValue,
  zoomValue,
  increase,
  sigma,
  occFrac,
  weights = numeric(0)
)

Arguments

coord

n x 2 matrix with the normalised coordinates of the points (nodes followed by edge midpoints).

SignalOut

n x 1 matrix with the combined signal (test vs control).

signalExp

n x 1 matrix with the test signal.

signalCtrl

n x 1 matrix with the control signal.

resolutionValue

side of the square output grid.

zoomValue

coordinate of the lower-left corner of the grid.

increase

grid step, in coordinate units.

sigma

kernel width, in grid cells.

occFrac

fraction of the occupancy produced by an isolated point below which the cell is considered background and gets NA.

weights

optional n-vector of non-negative support weights, one per point. A point of weight w counts as w copies of itself in both the numerator and the occupancy; weight 0 removes it. Empty means all ones.

Value

List with m1 (combined signal), m2 (test), m3 (control) and occ (relative network occupancy), all of them resolutionValue x resolutionValue matrices.
